title: Tool design
summary: Tool design makes available actions clear, bounded, and easy for an agent to use correctly.
overview: A tool is an interface with a purpose, inputs, outputs, and failure behavior. Its descriptions and response shape affect both tool selection and the context consumed.
why: Ambiguous tools can cause incorrect actions even when the model understands the task.
example: Provide search_incidents(service, start_time, limit) with incident IDs and short summaries instead of returning every log entry.
judgment: Choose the right action granularity and distinguish an empty result from a failed lookup.
next: Which tool-selection mistakes recur when we evaluate realistic incident tasks?
